comment: youtube_privacy_status is 'unlisted' by design -- this is the HUMAN APPROVAL gate: every run publishes unlisted, a person reviews it, and only then flips it to public in YouTube Studio. video_duration_seconds is gone -- each scene's length is now driven by its own Piper narration duration (see assemble_video.py PADDING_SECONDS/MIN_SCENE_SECONDS), not a fixed target. youtube_category_id changed from 26 (Film & Animation) to 27 (Education), matching the new narrated general-topic content.
